nameOfQualification: Welder (Manual Metal Arc Welding and Gas Cutting)
description: Welds and assembles metal pieces and products by using handheld welding equipment. Sets up parts for welding; uses hand tools, clamps, jigs and fixtures.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Work in real job situation with special emphasis on basic safety and hazards in this domain.
Recognize various defect of welding for plates and pipes.
Set up gas welding plant and Perform gas welding and gas cutting following safety precautions
Perform arc welding in different jointeger of two plates having different thicknesses
Demonstrate different types of weld joins with neat and appropriate sketch for welding different types of materials
Demonstrate different types of electrodes, their symbols, welding symbols, edge preparation
Illustrate the formation of arc and principle of arc welding with parameters and related terms
Recognize the application of electricity in welding

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELAVANTEXPERIENCEINYEARS: 3 years experience as a welder and flame cutter

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant qualification of NSQF Level 2.5
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELAVANTEXPERIENCEINYEARS: 1.5 years experience as a welder and flame cutter

verticalPathName: Metal Inert Gas/ Metal Active Gas/ Gas Metal Arc Welder (MIG/MAG/GMAW)
